subject: Harper Mills - leveling review and offer coordination
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Harper Mills - leveling review and offer coordination

Team —

Quick summary: we completed final loop for Harper Mills (SWE candidate for Core Infra). Interview feedback is split: two interviewers scored L4 (mid) and two scored L5 (senior). My read: Harper has repeatedly demonstrated cross-team impact (runtime optimizations shipped that touched infra + product), owned rollout across 3 teams, and led design/mentorship during on-call rotations. I believe the candidate is a borderline L5 and would ask HR to consider L5 for leveling.

Attachments: harper_mills_resume.pdf, interview-notes-compiled.pdf, comp-band-snapshot.csv

Why I'm asking for L5:
- Scope: led design & rollout of a telemetry ingestion change that reduced latency across services by ~18%.
- Autonomy: made cross-team tradeoffs and negotiated SLAs without lead hand-holding.
- Influence: mentored two engineers who were later promoted.

We have an external competing offer on the table. Monica is ready to present an offer this afternoon, but I want HR to weigh in before we put numbers on the table. If L5 is not approvable, I'm open to a heavier comp package at L4 with a written 6-month leveling review.

Can you advise next steps and whether we can expedite a leveling decision? If helpful, I can pull example PRs and a short write-up.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Core Infra
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Harper Mills - leveling review and offer coordination

Thanks for the context, Marissa —

I appreciate the summary. A couple quick asks so I can run this through leveling committee:
1) Can you map the specific examples to our leveling rubric (impact, scope, complexity, influence) — 1–2 bullets per category.
2) Please attach any PRs or public artifacts you want the committee to see (or paste links).
3) Confirm the competing offer timeline and whether we should pause verbal outreach while we review.

Operational constraints: the bar for an immediate L5 at hire requires VP-level sign-off if it falls outside the calibration band for the role. If we can't make L5, HR can approve an L4 offer with an elevated comp package and a documented 6-month level review process. Either path is fine — we just need to be explicit about criteria and approvals.

I can prioritize a committee read tomorrow morning if you get the mapping to me today.

– David
David Kim
People Partner, Recruiting & Talent Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Harper Mills - leveling review and offer coordination

David —

Mapping to rubric (high level):
- Impact: Designed and led telemetry ingestion rewrite that reduced tail latencies by ~18% and improved SLO attainment for two downstream products (see linked PRs).
- Scope: Owned cross-team rollout plan including compatibility shim, DB migration, and coordination with two product teams; tracked and resolved post-deploy regressions.
- Complexity: Implemented a novel batching strategy to avoid amplification under load; required changes to KV cache across services.
- Influence: Led design reviews and mentored two ICs; one was promoted to II last cycle.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-work-sample (includes PR excerpts and design doc)
Competing offer: Candidate has an expressed deadline of Monday 2/16 to accept verbally.

If helpful I can pull the PR numbers into the doc — I prioritized the summary for speed. Happy to expand.

Marissa
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Harper Mills - leveling review and offer coordination

Team —

We ran Harper's materials through a quick calibration read this morning. Notes attached: leveling-committee-notes.pdf. Summary of options and HR recommendation:

Option A (HR preferred operational path): Offer at L4 with a market-elevated comp package (base + sign-on) and a documented 6-month performance & leveling checkpoint. This path keeps us within calibration bands and simplifies approval.

Option B (approved elevation): Make an L5 hire at offer. To do this at hire we need explicit VP sign-off since this falls above the role band for the requisition. If leadership signs off, Compensation will need to approve a one-off leveling exception and we will document rationale.

Risks:
- Option A may lead the candidate to take competing offer if the delta is significant.
- Option B requires VP approval and will set a precedent for this req; compensated properly it may be justified by cross-team impact.

Please confirm which path you want to take. If you want Option B, please get Stephanie or the hiring VP to approve on-thread so we have a paper trail. If you go Option A, Monica — please prepare an offer package and we will route for comp approval.

Thanks,
David
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Harper Mills - leveling review and offer coordination

Thanks for the fast turnaround. I reviewed the committee notes and the rubric mapping — I'm sympathetic to Marissa's assessment. Given the candidate's cross-team impact and the risk of losing them to a competing offer, I'm willing to approve an L5 elevation under controlled conditions.

Conditions I want documented before offer:
1) Title at hire: L4 (to keep org chart alignment) OR L5 if Marissa explicitly wants the title to match. Either is acceptable to me; prefer L4+comp if we need to limit precedent.
2) Compensation: make market-competitive with a sign-on that bridges the gap. Compensation must be signed off by Comp Ops.
3) 6-month measurable review: Marissa to document 3 objective metrics that, if met, will convert the hire to L5 with retroactive adjustment if appropriate (or standard promotion if title started at L4). Metrics should include measurable impact (e.g., latency improvement target, cross-team deliverable, and mentorship/leadership milestones).
4) Write-up: Marissa — please prepare a short justification (2–3 paragraphs) and the 3 KPIs by end of day Monday 2/16. HR will finalize paperwork once we have that.

If Marissa confirms she will own the KPIs, David and Monica — proceed to prepare the offer draft (L4 with L5 comp or L5 title + comp) and hold verbal outreach until the KPIs and comp numbers are locked.

— Stephanie
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Harper Mills - leveling review and offer coordination

Thanks all — I will draft the 2–3 paragraph justification and the 3 objective KPIs by EOD today and share the doc link here.

Monica: please hold off on any verbal offer until HR confirms the comp band we finalize. If we need to do L4 title + L5 comp, I'm comfortable with that and will own the 6-month conversion process.

I'll post the draft in the Drive link and tag the committee.

-Marissa
Engineering Manager, Core Infra
Redwood Inference
